title: FluidVideo
tagline: A patreon decentralized streaming platform where streamers receive tips and funds through a money stream
description: This project uses Livepeer to stream online content. The content streamed is paid for by the viewers using a Superfluid stream of money that consistently sends money to the streamer. We also implemented a tipping method where the users can send one time payment to streamers. We use the Polygon blockchain to make sure the gas fees are low.
how_its_made: The project uses Livepeer streams behind the scene.When a streamer wants to create a stream, we open up a Livepeer stream for him and he can easily connect his favorite streaming software to send the content there. Once the streamer starts streaming, people can find his stream through our platform and can watch the streams. Streams are payable via a Superfluid money stream that the streamer previously set the rate at. Users can also send one time payment as tip if wanted. We use the Polygon chain to make sure the gas fees are kept low. We also used Moralis as our way to interact with contracts, to get live updates and to have a decentralized database where our metadata is stored.
